author: sijun
description: 接管群聊触发判定与上下文窗口：多样规则决策（计数 / 概率 / 节奏 / 模型判定）、唤醒&必回与休息时段开关、配额与退避、自管窗口，替代默认聊天的掷骰子判定。

en.description: Takes over group-chat trigger decisions and the context window: multi-rule decisions (count / probability / pacing / model-judged), wake & must-reply and rest-window switches, quota and backoff, plus a self-managed window — replacing the default dice-roll judgement.
